python.package: RadioButtons for toggle, Text for input, HTML for feedback

constraints.constraint: ADR-004: Dual mode - Tech Field is primary mode, Custom IPC is secondary. Only one mode active at a time.
ADR-003: Constrain input via validation. IPC pattern: ^[A-H]\d{2}[A-Z]?$ - Section (A-H), Class (2 digits), optional Subclass (letter).
IN SCOPE: Mode toggle, IPC input, validation, state updates. OUT OF SCOPE: IPC autocomplete (future), Query execution (Epic 3).
Maximum 5 IPC codes per query. Enforce in validation, show feedback.
This story MODIFIES existing files. Follow patterns from Story 2.3. Reuse observe() callback pattern.
Remove placeholder note: "Mode toggle coming in Story 2.4" from notebook Cell 2.

interface.name: tech_mode_toggle
interface.signature: def tech_mode_toggle(self) -> widgets.RadioButtons: """Toggle between Tech Field and Custom IPC/CPC modes""" toggle = widgets.RadioButtons( options=['Tech Field', 'Custom IPC/CPC'], value='Tech Field', description='Mode:', disabled=False ) toggle.observe(self._on_tech_mode_change, names='value') return toggle

interface.name: ipc_input
interface.signature: def ipc_input(self) -> widgets.Text: """Text input for comma-separated IPC codes""" text = widgets.Text( placeholder='A61B, H01L, ...', description='IPC Codes:', disabled=False, layout=widgets.Layout(width='400px') ) text.observe(self._on_ipc_input_change, names='value') return text

interface.name: _validate_ipc_codes
interface.signature: def _validate_ipc_codes(self, input_text: str) -> Tuple[List[str], bool, str]: """Validate IPC codes and return (valid_codes, is_valid, message)""" import re pattern = re.compile(r'^[A-H]\d{2}[A-Z]?$') codes = [c.strip().upper() for c in input_text.split(',') if c.strip()] valid_codes = [c for c in codes if pattern.match(c)][:5] # Max 5 ...

interface.name: _on_tech_mode_change
interface.signature: def _on_tech_mode_change(self, change): """Toggle visibility between tech field dropdown and IPC input""" if change['new'] == 'Custom IPC/CPC': self._tech_dropdown.layout.display = 'none' self._ipc_input.layout.display = '' self.state.tech_mode = 'ipc' self.state.tech_field = None else: self._tech_dropdown.layout.display = '' self._ipc_input.layout.display = 'none' self.state.tech_mode = 'field' self.state.ipc_codes = []
